_comment: Documentation-sync policy for centinelas-pr (thehub-pr ADR 0010). Read by tools/check_docs_sync.py. couplings: when a covered path changes, the doc must change in the same diff, or the commit/PR says 'Docs-Impact: none - <reason>'. Seeded conservatively: each coupling was replayed over this repo's recent human-authored changes and never fired. Add couplings for docs that enumerate things; do not add ones that fire on routine work.

couplings.why: 'Desktop app' lists one double-click launcher per platform.
'Setup / Development' and 'Shared spatial baseline' tell contributors to run these scripts and name the grid file, inside code blocks that the reference check does not read.
'Setup / Development' states which Python versions CI tests and that the lint job gates on ruff.
'Repository files' lists the parity manifest, baseline, detector, tests and gate.
